title: YOUR OPERATOR TALKS
why: His number 45 and his answer 26 b, short voice barks. Reloading, running dry, throwing a frag, stringing a tripwire, going down and starting a heal were only written on the screen, where nobody in a fight is looking. Now a short spoken bark plays with each: RELOADING, OUT OF AMMO, FRAG OUT, TRIPWIRE SET, I AM DOWN and HEALING, and SCORE LOST in the 2 player demo. They are spoken in a clipped radio voice that cuts through a fight, one at a time with a gap between them so a busy moment never stacks voices, and they follow the split speakers like every other sound.
now: Short spoken barks: RELOADING, OUT OF AMMO, FRAG OUT, TRIPWIRE SET, DOWN, HEALING.
